text_block_list.text:
I was interviewed for the academy newspaper as a Trainer.
After that—
I suddenly realized Mejiro Dober was staring intently in my direction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's so completely natural, even with all those cameras...
I wish... I could be like that too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh... N-No. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's none of your business.
...This is my problem.
I suddenly remembered how, while looking this way, she had quietly murmured, "If only I... could be like that too..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh, why...

It seems she really is uncomfortable in front of the camera.
Wanting to help if I could, I decided to offer some advice.
choice_data_list: Let's train up your body and build up some confidence!
Let's practice smiling in front of the mirror!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-If it's okay with you...
Could you teach me the secret to taking good photos?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not good with being the center of attention.
Even during interviews, I can never smile properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, deep down, I really wanted to be captured
with a proud, confident smile...
choice_data_list: Let's train up your body and build up some confidence!
Let's practice smiling in front of the mirror!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Not that I asked, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Confidence, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see. If I can gain some confidence,
maybe I'll be able to smile naturally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'll give it a shot to build up my stamina too.
Thank you.
Saying that, she walked away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...If I could just gain some confidence, maybe I'd be able to smile naturally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'll give it a try if I feel like it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A mirror...? What's that? How weird.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Smiling in front of a mirror... huh.
That's pretty embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, my...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll... keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's easy to do, and being able
to see how you look might be a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'll give  a try.
